target: Trajectory-P2-C — Attributed Execution Trajectory & Handoff Preview

questions.question: How does P2-C obtain a verified Session identity from the durable association service?
questions.answer: Call makeAssociationQualifier(...).qualifyAttempt({projectId, attemptId}) and consume a qualification whose state is ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED. The service returns the verified SessionId, the owning InvocationId, the durable binding reference and an H1-compatible AttemptSessionAssociation.

questions.question: Why does the SessionId not come from Caller Claim?
questions.answer: The SessionId is taken from a committed durable observation whose sourceBasis matched the verifier's own trusted basis AND whose header was re-read through the official DSH reader. A caller claim has no path into the store, and the read side never consults the record's own declaration.

questions.question: How is the target Invocation selected?
questions.answer: P2-C must select an Invocation explicitly (or ask for all of them). The qualifier qualifies EACH invocation of an attempt independently and returns a summary, so P2-C can require exactly one qualified invocation or report the ambiguity.

questions.question: How are multiple Invocations for one Attempt represented?
questions.answer: The durable model is Attempt -> Invocation(s) -> Session candidate(s). qualifyAttempt returns one qualification per invocation; a retried attempt yields several. The latest Session is never auto-selected.

questions.question: How is a conflicting association refused?
questions.answer: An invocation with two or more distinct observed SessionIds returns state CONFLICT with ALL candidates visible; no single identity is established, so no verified SessionId is produced.

questions.question: How is the official DSH Reader invoked only after association admission?
questions.answer: The reader is invoked inside the qualifier, AFTER the durable record, basis match, Work re-read and cardinality checks pass. P2-C should keep the same order: admission first, read second.

questions.question: How are Session Header and Page Integrity rechecked?
questions.answer: The header is re-read at qualification time (readHeaderIdentity). P2-C should additionally run validateSessionEventPage over any event page it admits, exactly as H1 established.

questions.question: How are Event Durability and Fork Inheritance preserved?
questions.answer: P2-C should consume the existing DshSessionEventPage durability provenance (PERSISTED_DSH_EVENT vs SYNTHETIC_RECOVERY_EVENT) and the inherited flags from the official reader; P2-B stores no event bodies, so nothing is duplicated.

questions.question: How is ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT made consistent with BOUND_VERIFIED?
questions.answer: P2-C must enforce the cross-field invariant: a state with sessionBindingStatus = SESSION_CLAIMED_UNVERIFIED and dshSessionId = null must NOT carry sessionReadAdmission = ADMITTED_TO_ATTEMPT. Admission requires a qualified association. This is a FUTURE integration requirement; P2-B does not touch the preview path.

questions.question: Why can a structural Page Validator alone not establish producer authenticity?
questions.answer: Page integrity validates shape, contiguity and coverage; it says nothing about WHICH execution produced the session. Producer authenticity comes from the durable association, which requires a trusted basis match and a Work re-read.

questions.question: How is an unavailable Session represented without fabricating an empty history?
questions.answer: Qualification returns SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE with the reader's own readState and detail; P2-C must surface that state rather than an empty event list. A failed read is never an empty history.

questions.question: Why does a complete observed event range not prove Work settlement or Session termination?
questions.answer: Events describe what the Session did. Settlement is canonical Work's; termination is the Session's. P2-B's own gate demonstrates the separation: the Attempt remained RUNNING while a real session existed and was read.

questions.question: How may Project Evolution and Execution views be combined without a false atomic snapshot?
questions.answer: They are read from separate owners at separate times. P2-C should present them as separately-sourced views with their own timestamps and never claim a single atomic cross-owner snapshot.

questions.question: Which APIs must remain read-only?
questions.answer: The qualifier, the official DSH reader and the Trajectory preview are read-only. The ONLY writer is the trusted recorder on the ingestion path. P2-C must not add a write path.

questions.question: Which actual product paths still require live model testing later?
questions.answer: A production worker that passes capability admission and runs a real model turn; automatic Handoff; and any PRIMARY execution. P2-B exercised only the no-model creation+refusal seam.

minimalNextSlice: compose the qualifier into the Attempt Preview as a read-side source: obtain a verified SessionId only from an ASSOCIATION_QUALIFIED result, then read events through the official reader with page-integrity validation, and enforce the cross-field admission invariant.
